  background:var(--color-white);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
  padding-top:calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--ticker-height));
}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;border:none;background:none}
ul{list-style:none}
.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

/* ===== SKIP LINK ===== */
.skip-link{
  position:absolute;top:-100%;left:16px;background:var(--color-primary);color:var(--color-white);
  padding:8px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);z-index:10000;font-weight:600;transition:top 0.2s;
}
.skip-link:focus{top:8px}

/* ===== HEADER / NAV ===== */
.site-header{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;background:var(--color-white);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);height:var(--nav-height);
}
.header-inner{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  height:100%;max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--color-primary);flex-shrink:0}
.logo-icon{width:32px;height:32px;background:var(--color-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--color-white);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700}
.main-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:100%}
.nav-item{position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-trigger{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-dark);transition:background 0.2s,color 0.2s;
  cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;font-family:inherit;white-space:nowrap;
}
.nav-trigger:hover,.nav-trigger:focus-visible{background:var(--color-gray-100);color:var(--color-primary)}
.nav-trigger .chevron{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform 0.2s ease;opacity:0.5}
.nav-item.active .nav-trigger{color:var(--color-primary);background:var(--color-primary-light)}
.nav-item.active .nav-trigger .chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);opacity:1}
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.btn-subscribe{
  padding:8px 18px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--color-primary);
  color:var(--color-white);font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;transition:background 0.2s;
}
.btn-subscribe:hover,.btn-subscribe:focus-visible{background:var(--color-primary-dark)}
.btn-signin{
  padding:8px 14px;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-dark);
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);transition:background 0.2s;
}
.btn-signin:hover,.btn-signin:focus-visible{background:var(--color-gray-100)}
.mobile-menu-btn{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:8px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm)}
.mobile-menu-btn span{width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--color-dark);border-radius:2px;transition:transform 0.2s,opacity 0.2s}

/* ===== MEGA MENU DROPDOWN ===== */
.mega-dropdown{
  position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  background:var(--color-white);border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);
  padding:28px 32px;min-width:520px;z-index:999;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity 0.2s,visibility 0.2s;
}
.nav-item.active .mega-dropdown,.mega-dropdown:focus-within{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
}
.mega-dropdown-wide{min-width:660px}
.mega-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px 24px}
.mega-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.dropdown-title{
  font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;
  color:var(--color-gray-400);margin-bottom:10px;grid-column:1/-1;
}
.dropdown-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.dropdown-link{
  font-size:0.875rem;color:var(--color-dark-light);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  transition:background 0.15s,color 0.15s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.dropdown-link:hover,.dropdown-link:focus-visible{background:var(--color-primary-light);color:var(--color-primary)}
.dropdown-highlight{
  border-top:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;
}
.dropdown-highlight .dropdown-link{font-weight:600}

/* ===== CREDIBILITY TICKER ===== */
.ticker-bar{
  position:fixed;top:var(--nav-height);left:0;right:0;z-index:999;
  height:var(--ticker-height);background:var(--color-primary);overflow:hidden;
}
.ticker-track{
  display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;white-space:nowrap;
  animation:ticker-scroll 28s linear infinite;
}
.ticker-item{
  flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 28px;
  color:var(--color-white);font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.02em;
}
.ticker-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);flex-shrink:0}
.ticker-icon{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0}
@keyframes ticker-scroll{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ticker-track{animation:none}
  .ticker-bar{overflow-x:auto}
  .ticker-track{gap:0}
}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero{
  padding:56px 0 64px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--color-white) 0%,var(--color-gray-50) 100%);
}
.hero-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero-content{max-width:560px}
.hero-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--color-primary-light);
  color:var(--color-primary);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;
  margin-bottom:20px;letter-spacing:0.03em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.hero-badge-icon{width:18px;height:18px}
.hero-title{
  font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.2;color:var(--color-dark);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.hero-subtitle{font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--color-gray-600);margin-bottom:28px;line-height:1.6}
.hero-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-primary{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 28px;
  background:var(--color-primary);color:var(--color-white);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);transition:background 0.2s,transform 0.15s;
}
.btn-primary:hover,.btn-primary:focus-visible{background:var(--color-primary-dark);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-outline{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 28px;
  border:2px solid var(--color-gray-200);color:var(--color-dark);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);transition:border-color 0.2s,background 0.2s;
}
.btn-outline:hover,.btn-outline:focus-visible{border-color:var(--color-primary);background:var(--color-primary-light)}
.hero-visual{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;
}
.hero-image-wrapper{
  width:100%;max-width:440px;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E6F3F4 0%,#D2E9EA 50%,#B8DFE0 100%);
  border-radius:var(--radius-xl);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-image-content{
  text-align:center;padding:24px;position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.hero-challenge-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--color-white);
  padding:8px 16px;border-radius:24px;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--color-primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);margin-bottom:12px;
}
.hero-image-text{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--color-dark);line-height:1.2}
.hero-image-sub{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--color-gray-600);margin-top:8px}

/* ===== SECTION COMMONS ===== */
.section{padding:64px 0}
.section-header{margin-bottom:40px}
.section-label{
  font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;
  color:var(--color-primary);margin-bottom:8px;
}
.section-title{
  font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:700;
  color:var(--color-dark);line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:12px;
}
.section-subtitle{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--color-gray-600);max-width:640px}
.section-header-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px}
.view-all{
  font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--color-primary);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  transition:color 0.2s;
}
.view-all:hover,.view-all:focus-visible{color:var(--color-primary-dark)}
.view-all .arrow{transition:transform 0.2s}
.view-all:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(3px)}

/* ===== TRENDING ===== */
.trending{background:var(--color-white)}
.trending-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:40px;align-items:start}
.trending-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.trending-sidebar{
  background:var(--color-gray-50);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:24px;
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
}
.trending-sidebar-title{
  font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.trending-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.trending-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.trending-category{
  font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;
  color:var(--color-primary);
}
.trending-title{
  font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--color-dark);line-height:1.4;transition:color 0.15s;
}
.trending-item:hover .trending-title{color:var(--color-primary)}
.trending-featured-card{
  background:var(--color-white);border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s;cursor:pointer;
}
.trending-featured-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.trending-featured-img{
  height:200px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D0EAEC 0%,#A8D5D9 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.trending-featured-img-inner{
  text-align:center;color:var(--color-primary-dark);
}
.trending-featured-img-icon{width:48px;height:48px;margin:0 auto 8px;opacity:0.7}
.trending-featured-body{padding:20px}
.trending-featured-body .trending-category{margin-bottom:8px}
.trending-featured-headline{
  font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px;
}

/* ===== NEWSLETTER CTA ===== */
.newsletter-cta{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--color-primary) 0%,#016670 100%);
  padding:56px 0;color:var(--color-white);
}
.newsletter-inner{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;
}
.newsletter-content{max-width:480px}
.newsletter-heading{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px}
.newsletter-body{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;opacity:0.9;margin-bottom:24px}
.newsletter-form{display:flex;gap:10px;max-width:480px}
.newsletter-input{
  flex:1;padding:14px 18px;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  font-size:1rem;font-family:inherit;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s;min-width:0;
}
.newsletter-input:focus{border-color:var(--color-accent)}
.btn-join{
  padding:14px 28px;background:var(--color-accent);color:var(--color-white);
  font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:none;
  cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn-join:hover,.btn-join:focus-visible{background:var(--color-accent-hover)}
.newsletter-privacy{font-size:0.8rem;opacity:0.7;margin-top:12px}
.newsletter-success{display:none;padding:16px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:var(--radius-md);font-weight:600}
.newsletter-visual{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.newsletter-illustration{
  width:100%;max-width:360px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:var(--radius-xl);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:16px;padding:32px;
}
.newsletter-icon-stack{display:flex;gap:-8px}
.newsletter-icon-circle{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.5rem;
}

/* ===== HEALTH TOPICS ===== */
.health-topics{background:var(--color-gray-50)}
.carousel-wrapper{position:relative}
.carousel-container{
  overflow-x:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;
  padding-bottom:8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
.carousel-container::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.carousel-track{display:flex;gap:20px}
.topic-card{
  flex-shrink:0;width:160px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  padding:24px 16px;background:var(--color-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s,border-color 0.2s;
  cursor:pointer;text-align:center;
}
.topic-card:hover,.topic-card:focus-visible{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--color-primary);outline:none}
.topic-image{
  width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
}
.topic-label{font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--color-dark);line-height:1.3}
.carousel-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.carousel-btn{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  background:var(--color-white);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:border-color 0.2s,background 0.2s;flex-shrink:0;
}
.carousel-btn:hover,.carousel-btn:focus-visible{border-color:var(--color-primary);background:var(--color-primary-light)}
.carousel-btn:disabled{opacity:0.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.carousel-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--color-dark)}

/* ===== HEALTH TOOLS ===== */
.tools{background:var(--color-white)}
.tools-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
.tool-highlight-card{
  background:var(--color-primary-light);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:32px;
  border:1px solid #D0EAEC;
}
.tool-highlight-title{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
.tool-highlight-body{font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--color-gray-600);margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.5}
.btn-sm{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 20px;
  background:var(--color-primary);color:var(--color-white);font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);transition:background 0.2s;
}
.btn-sm:hover,.btn-sm:focus-visible{background:var(--color-primary-dark)}
.tools-list-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.tool-card{
  background:var(--color-gray-50);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:20px;
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s;cursor:pointer;
}
.tool-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.tool-card-icon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--color-white);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--color-primary);
}
.tool-card-title{font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.tool-card-desc{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--color-gray-500);line-height:1.4}

/* ===== RECOMMENDED READS ===== */
.rec-reads{background:var(--color-gray-50)}
.tabs-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:32px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--color-gray-200);padding-bottom:2px}
.tab-btn{
  padding:10px 18px;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-gray-500);
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;transition:color 0.2s,background 0.2s;
  position:relative;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;
}
.tab-btn::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-2px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:var(--color-primary);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform 0.2s;
}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--color-dark);background:var(--color-gray-100)}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--color-primary);font-weight:600}
.tab-btn.active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.articles-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;
  transition:opacity 0.25s;
}
.articles-grid.switching{opacity:0.5}
.article-card{
  background:var(--color-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s;cursor:pointer;
}
.article-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.article-img{
  height:180px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.article-img-content{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--color-primary-dark);text-align:center;padding:16px}
.article-body{padding:20px}
.article-tag{font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;color:var(--color-primary);margin-bottom:8px}
.article-headline{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:8px}
.article-meta{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--color-gray-400)}

/* ===== TRUST SECTION ===== */
.trust{background:var(--color-white)}
.trust-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:48px}
.trust-header .section-title{margin-bottom:8px}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}
.trust-card{
  text-align:center;padding:32px 20px;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  background:var(--color-gray-50);border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  transition:transform 0.2s,box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.trust-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
.trust-icon{
  width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 18px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:var(--color-primary-light);color:var(--color-primary);
}
.trust-icon svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.trust-card-title{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.trust-card-desc{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--color-gray-600);line-height:1.5}

/* ===== FEATURED PROGRAMS ===== */
.featured-programs{background:var(--color-gray-50)}
.programs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.program-card{
  background:var(--color-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s;cursor:pointer;
}
.program-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.program-img{
  height:140px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.program-img-content{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:12px;line-height:1.3}
.program-body{padding:16px}
.program-title{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}

/* ===== LATEST VIDEOS ===== */
.videos{background:var(--color-white)}
.videos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.video-card{
  background:var(--color-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--color-gray-200);transition:box-shadow 0.2s,transform 0.2s;cursor:pointer;
}
.video-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.video-thumb{
  height:180px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.video-play-btn{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--color-white);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);z-index:1;transition:transform 0.2s;
}
.video-card:hover .video-play-btn{transform:scale(1.1)}
.video-play-btn::after{
  content:'';width:0;height:0;border-style:solid;
  border-width:8px 0 8px 14px;border-color:transparent transparent transparent var(--color-primary);
  margin-left:3px;
}
.video-body{padding:16px}
.video-title{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
.site-footer{
  background:var(--color-dark);color:var(--color-white);padding:56px 0 0;
}
.footer-top{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:40px;

}
.footer-newsletter-heading{

}
.footer-newsletter-body{font-size:0.9rem;opacity:0.75;margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.5}
.footer-form{display:flex;gap:10px;max-width:440px}
.footer-input{
  flex:1;padding:12px 16px;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:0.9rem;font-family:inherit;outline:none;min-width:0;
}
.footer-input:focus{border-color:var(--color-accent)}
.btn-footer-signup{
  padding:12px 24px;background:var(--color-accent);color:var(--color-white);
  font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:none;
  cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn-footer-signup:hover,.btn-footer-signup:focus-visible{background:var(--color-accent-hover)}
.footer-social{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.social-link{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--color-white);
  transition:background 0.2s,border-color 0.2s;
}
.social-link:hover,.social-link:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4)}
.social-link svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.footer-mid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:32px;
  padding-bottom:40px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);margin-bottom:32px;
}
.footer-col-title{font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:16px;opacity:0.7}
.footer-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.footer-link{font-size:0.85rem;opacity:0.7;transition:opacity 0.2s}
.footer-link:hover,.footer-link:focus-visible{opacity:1}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding-bottom:32px}
.footer-legal{font-size:0.8rem;opacity:0.6;line-height:1.6;max-width:720px}
.footer-bottom-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px}
.footer-bottom-link{font-size:0.8rem;opacity:0.6;transition:opacity 0.2s}
.footer-bottom-link:hover,.footer-bottom-link:focus-visible{opacity:1}

/* ===== OVERLAY ===== */
.nav-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);z-index:998;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 0.2s,visibility 0.2s;
}
.nav-overlay.active{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
